top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under two were watching television.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The 5 staff files reviewed did not have form 2912 included.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver used profane language towards children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.
